speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: Sector agencies have also put in place strategies to build up the local talent pipeline for in-demand jobs.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: These provide detailed job-level insights into the impact of technology on the industry as well as the workforce.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: With these insights, we are then able to provide a wide range of programmes to help mid-career workers to transition into new jobs and at-risk workers to be reskilled and redeployed into new roles.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: Overall, our resident workforce has seen good employment outcomes.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: As our economy expanded, we have seen a shift towards higher value-added activities and the growth of modern services such as in Financial and Insurance Services, and Professional Services.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: Correspondingly, the profile of jobs in the economy has also shifted.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: The employment rate for residents aged 25 to 29 remained high at 85% in 2021.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: Unemployment rate for them have remained low at 4.7% in 2021.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: The real median income of full-time employed residents have also grown by 1.5% per annum from 2011 to 2021.
